notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.1.0-f2 and Thanks!
notes.content:
Patch Notes

Added: 
- Guaranteed way to get the [spoiler]"Blink and You'll Miss It"[/spoiler] Achievement
- Additional interaction with [spoiler]Alex's trash pile[/spoiler]
- Ability to remap Skip Cutscene input

Changed:
- Reduced waiting time of some secrets
- Updated Credits
- [spoiler]Improve skip behavior of Core introduction[/spoiler]

Fixed:
- Various bugs relating to continuity
- Issue preventing remapping scroll wheel down
- [spoiler]Core platforms being inconsistent per save file[/spoiler]

[hr][/hr]

Thank You!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43554274/0b3a172e8059fb0eb5616edcfa6e3a1d09e419b7.gif

Thank you all for playing and enjoying our game. Your support means the world to us and we couldn't have done it without you. Thank you!!!!

notes.title: Merch Sale!
notes.content:
To celebrate the launch of ENA: Dream BBQ Chapter 1, Fangamer is having a sale on the ENA Collection until April 9th!

The sale affects all Fangamer ENA merch, such as: plushes, T Shirts, pins, and everything else!

If you enjoy ENA: Dream BBQ and the ENA series, buying merch is a direct way to support JoelG and the ENA Team!

Check it out!

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.6
notes.content:
Added: 
- Low-Quality video preference available for most videos to fix stuttering on lower-end hardware

Changed:
- Updated credits
- Updated crosshair appearance for better visibility
- [spoiler]Phone dialing resets after 10 seconds of inactivity[/spoiler]

Fixed:
- Fix resolution dropdown not updating options when switching displays
- Miscellaneous bug fixes

SUPPORTER EDITION:
- Fixed Hourglass Dogs not always saving when collected

notes.title: Patch Notes: v1.0.5-f1
notes.content:
Added: 
- Option to change save slot recorded time type

Changed: 
- Default save slot time now uses real time instead of game time

Fixed: 
- Inaccurate and missing colliders that could cause softlocks
- Invalid reset position being used after teleporting within a level
- Miscellaneous bug fixes

notes.title: ENA Day Stream and Q&A!
notes.content:
Join Us for the ENA Day Dev Livestream on Youtube, Thursday Feb 23!

Celebrate ENA Day with us by joining our dev livestream on Youtube! JoelG and the team will be showing some new content and answering your questions about ENA: Dream BBQ.


Date: Thursday, February 23rd
Time: 4:00PM EST
Stream Link: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=nmkix2A0Rlc

Don't miss out on this opportunity to get a sneak peek at the game and connect with the development team. We can't wait to see you there!
